name: Tecyfy LLM API prices
description: The API price of every text model from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Alibaba, per million tokens: input, cached input, cache write, output, batch and long-prompt prices, with each model's context window, longest answer, capability score and the day its maker's price page was read.
units: US dollars per million tokens; context, maxOutput and longAbove in tokens
